object.attr: as implemented: mapped from the existing tests, with blind tests written from the requirements alone for what they missed.
object.description: With read-only mode off, change DOC-1's description from another program and activate the Document Editor, so that the Changed on disk banner shows. Try a grid cell edit, an Inspector description edit and New sibling. Expected: each is refused with a status message holding 'Reload first (F5)', the typed Inspector text stays in its field, the object files are unchanged and no object is added; no grid cell editor opens. While the banner shows, pick a status in the Inspector. Expected: the file is unchanged and the list shows the value on disk; the Inspector's fields can't be typed into; a Table menu action is refused with the same message. Reload from disk. Expected: a grid edit is written.
